exposure: Non-tubal ectopic pregnancy (NTEP) types (caesarean scar, cornual, cervical, ovarian pregnancy)
cohort: The study included 30 confirmed cases of non-tubal ectopic pregnancy patients who presented to Alqasmi Women and Children's Hospital, Sharjah, between October 2017 and October 2020.
finding: Patients with non-tubal ectopic pregnancy presented with varying symptoms and signs depending on the location, and the different available management options appeared effective and safe when carefully selected.
